---
name: Label suggestion
about: Suggest a change to a label's name or definition, or a case AIA doesn't handle well
title: "[Label] "
labels: label-suggestion
---

**Which label(s)?**
e.g. 1x3 Proxied

**What would you change?**
The new name, the new definition, or the case that doesn't fit.

**Why?**
A real example of writing where the current label is unclear, misleading, or missing helps most.
